verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs say a project is a real TypeScript and React app that you can read or export in full, and its self-hosting page says you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like. A full SQL dump is also available on any plan. missing for 10: detailed self-hosting/run instructions, clarity on whether platform-brokered services (OAuth, email, scheduled jobs) work outside Floot, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful external deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform

citations.quote: you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like.
A Floot project is a real TypeScript and React app — pages, components, and backend endpoints — and you can read or export all of it.
You can download a full SQL dump of your database at any time, on any plan
